transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I understand we have three vehicles scheduled for routine service tomorrow — M-12, V-8, and G-3 — but only one maintenance bay available. Before I sign off on the final maintenance sequence and release instructions, I need to hear from each of you on whether there are any changes or issues from your sections I should be aware of. Maintenance chief, dispatcher, supply NCO — what do you have for me?

transcript.text: Sir, I need to report a change from my section. During this morning's inspection, I confirmed that M-12 failed its brake-line integrity check. It must be held for brake repair before any return-to-service inspection. The result is documented in the maintenance worksheet but has not yet been entered on the draft board. M-12 should not be scheduled for routine service tomorrow — it needs brake repair first.
